{
  "sprint_goal": "Deliver a secure, production-ready MVP payment admin workspace integrating PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs for search, approvals, refunds, anomaly alerts, and audit export.",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "T-001",
      "title": "Implement merchant and payment batch search UI",
      "description": "Build Next.js search components using shadcn/ui, integrate PaymentCore GraphQL and Payment Rail REST APIs via API Gateway for query data, ensuring <1.5s response time.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 8.0,
      "dependencies": []
    },
    {
      "id": "T-002",
      "title": "Develop settlement timeline visualization",
      "description": "Create timeline component with event stream grouping per payment rail type (ACH, RTP, wire). Integrate Payment Rail API data and implement responsive layout.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-003",
      "title": "Integrate refund and adjustment triggers",
      "description": "Set up backend connector to Payment Actions service to process refund/adjustment actions with mTLS+OAuth2 authentication and emit audit logs to Kafka and S3.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-004",
      "title": "Develop approval workflow with automated allocation rules",
      "description": "Implement Manager view for payout approval using PaymentCore data, trigger Payment Rail disbursements, enforce RBAC gating, and log actions to audit topics.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-003"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-005",
      "title": "Implement RBAC middleware and feature gating",
      "description": "Configure RBAC roles (OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor) within workspace with route-level and component-level gating, ensuring no privilege escalation.",
      "category": "Security",
      "estimated_hours": 4.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-001"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-006",
      "title": "Build audit-ready report export module",
      "description": "Develop Auditor view to fetch S3 archived logs via gateway and generate audit-ready CSV/XLSX files for selected date ranges, adhering to SOX compliance.",
      "category": "Backend",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-005"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-007",
      "title": "Implement anomaly alert display in batch views",
      "description": "Render real-time alerts from Payment Rail event streams, highlight anomalies, and add quick investigation links in batch detail UI.",
      "category": "Frontend",
      "estimated_hours": 3.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-002"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-008",
      "title": "Performance and integration testing",
      "description": "Test API round-trip times, role access validation, payout initiation SLA, audit log delivery to Kafka/S3, and UI responsiveness under load.",
      "category": "Testing",
      "estimated_hours": 5.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-004","T-006","T-007"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-009",
      "title": "Deployment pipeline setup inside private VNet",
      "description": "Configure CI/CD for Next.js and backend APIs using existing runners in private VNet, ensure mTLS and OAuth2 secrets managed securely, deploy to prod environment.",
      "category": "DevOps",
      "estimated_hours": 6.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-008"]
    },
    {
      "id": "T-010",
      "title": "Create workspace usage documentation",
      "description": "Develop internal guide explaining search, approval, refund processes, RBAC behaviors, and audit log handling for Ops, Managers, and Auditors.",
      "category": "Documentation",
      "estimated_hours": 2.0,
      "dependencies": ["T-009"]
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "id": "R-001",
      "description": "API latency exceeds performance targets during integration testing affecting search and payout initiation times.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Implement query caching and pagination, collaborate with infra team for API gateway tuning and parallel requests."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-002",
      "description": "Audit log emission failures or Kafka/S3 downtime risk incomplete compliance records.",
      "severity": "High",
      "mitigation": "Add retry mechanism and alerting for failed audit emissions; validate S3 archive success post-deployment."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-003",
      "description": "RBAC misconfiguration may allow unauthorized access to approval actions.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Perform manual role simulation testing and integrate automated permission validation in CI."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-004",
      "description": "Integration dependencies on Payment Rail API schemas could change mid-sprint.",
      "severity": "Medium",
      "mitigation": "Use versioned API endpoints and coordinate with API owners before sprint commit."
    },
    {
      "id": "R-005",
      "description": "Deployment in private VNet may delay CI/CD setup due to restricted network policies.",
      "severity": "Low",
      "mitigation": "Pre-request network firewall exceptions and reuse existing runner configurations."
    }
  ],
  "definition_of_done": [
    "All user stories pass functional and integration tests.",
    "Performance meets <1.5s search and <4s payout SLA under load testing.",
    "RBAC verified for OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor without escalation.",
    "Audit logs confirmed in Kafka and S3 for all actions.",
    "Workspace deployed to production environment inside private VNet.",
    "Documentation completed and reviewed by Treasury Operations stakeholders."
  ],
  "total_estimated_hours": 50.0
}

{
  "architecture_overview": "The Payment Admin Workspace architecture consists of a Next.js 14 + TypeScript frontend integrated with backend services through a secure API Gateway using mTLS and OAuth2 client credentials. The backend integrates with PaymentCore (GraphQL) for ledger and merchant data, Payment Rail REST APIs for settlement and disbursement details, and Payment Actions for refunds and adjustments. Audit events are asynchronously emitted to Kafka and archived in S3. RBAC controls are enforced across routes and UI components. The system runs inside a private VNet ensuring compliance and security.",
  "technology_stack": ["Next.js 14", "TypeScript", "Node.js", "GraphQL", "REST APIs", "Kafka", "AWS S3", "OAuth2", "mTLS", "shadcn/ui"],
  "api_endpoints": [
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/merchants/search",
      "description": "Search and filter merchants and payment batches by date, merchant ID, and status",
      "request_body": "{\"merchantId\": \"string\", \"startDate\": \"ISODate\", \"endDate\": \"ISODate\", \"status\": \"string\"}",
      "response": "{\"results\": [{\"merchantId\": \"string\", \"batchId\": \"string\", \"status\": \"string\", \"amount\": \"number\"}], \"count\": \"number\"}"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/batches/:batchId/settlement-timeline",
      "description": "Retrieve settlement timeline events for ACH, RTP, and wire payment rails",
      "request_body": "none",
      "response": "{\"batchId\": \"string\", \"railEvents\": [{\"rail\": \"ACH|RTP|WIRE\", \"timestamp\": \"ISODate\", \"status\": \"string\"}]}"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/actions/refund",
      "description": "Trigger refund or adjustment via Payment Actions service",
      "request_body": "{\"paymentId\": \"string\", \"reason\": \"string\", \"amount\": \"number\"}",
      "response": "{\"status\": \"initiated\", \"actionId\": \"string\"}"
    },
    {
      "method": "POST",
      "path": "/api/payouts/approve",
      "description": "Approve merchant payouts via Manager role and automated allocation rules",
      "request_body": "{\"payoutId\": \"string\", \"approvedBy\": \"string\"}",
      "response": "{\"payoutId\": \"string\", \"status\": \"approved\", \"auditLogId\": \"string\"}"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/reports/audit-export",
      "description": "Export audit-ready report of payment actions from S3 archives",
      "request_body": "{\"startDate\": \"ISODate\", \"endDate\": \"ISODate\", \"format\": \"CSV|XLSX\"}",
      "response": "{\"downloadUrl\": \"string\"}"
    },
    {
      "method": "GET",
      "path": "/api/anomalies/:batchId",
      "description": "Retrieve real-time anomaly alerts for a payment batch",
      "request_body": "none",
      "response": "{\"batchId\": \"string\", \"alerts\": [{\"type\": \"delay|mismatch\", \"description\": \"string\", \"severity\": \"Low|Medium|High\"}]}"
    }
  ],
  "database_schema": "Since all data is fetched through PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs (read-only replicas), no direct schema modifications occur. The logical schema includes tables: merchants(id, name, region), payment_batches(id, merchant_id, status, amount, rail_type, created_at), payouts(id, batch_id, approved_by, status, approved_at), audit_logs(action_id, user_id, role, timestamp, payload). These are conceptual mappings based on GraphQL schema from PaymentCore.",
  "security_considerations": [
    "Use mTLS and OAuth2 client credentials for all API Gateway calls.",
    "RBAC enforcement across OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles at API and UI layers.",
    "No direct DB writes—mutation only through Payment Actions service.",
    "Emit audit logs for all actions to Kafka and backup snapshots in S3 with retriable delivery.",
    "Deploy inside private VNet with restricted network egress.",
    "Sanitize all API inputs and enforce strict request schema validation.",
    "Apply CSRF and XSS protections in Next.js frontend."
  ],
  "code_structure": {
    "frontend": {
      "folders": [
        "src/components/search/",
        "src/components/timeline/",
        "src/components/alerts/",
        "src/pages/merchant/",
        "src/pages/batch/",
        "src/pages/reports/",
        "src/hooks/",
        "src/context/auth/"
      ]
    },
    "backend": {
      "folders": [
        "src/api/routes/",
        "src/api/controllers/",
        "src/api/services/paymentCore/",
        "src/api/services/paymentRails/",
        "src/api/services/paymentActions/",
        "src/middleware/rbac/",
        "src/utils/auditEmitter/",
        "src/config/"
      ]
    },
    "shared": {
      "folders": [
        "src/types/",
        "src/constants/",
        "src/tests/"
      ]
    }
  },
  "implementation_notes": "Use Next.js App Router with React 18 server components for fast rendering and caching. Integrate PaymentCore GraphQL queries using Apollo Client with application-layer caching. Implement RBAC middleware verifying JWT claims from OAuth2 tokens. All mutation actions (refunds, approvals) route through Payment Actions service with audit emission events dispatched to Kafka topic 'audit.payments' and S3 storage. Use async worker for Kafka emission retries. Anomaly alerts use WebSocket or SSE channels via API Gateway to maintain real-time updates. Ensure pagination and debounced search requests for <1.5s response times. Follow existing design tokens in shadcn/ui for visual consistency. Deploy via CI/CD runner inside private VNet with secure secret management."
}

{
  "test_strategy": "Adopt a layered testing strategy combining unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security testing tailored for a Next.js + Node.js architecture integrated with PaymentCore (GraphQL) and Payment Rail REST APIs. Use Jest for unit tests, Supertest for API integration tests, Cypress for E2E UI validation, Locust for performance load simulation, and OWASP ZAP for security scanning. Ensure RBAC validation and audit logging are covered through both automated tests and manual validation within staging. CI/CD pipelines will execute test suites automatically inside the private VNet with parallel test runs.",
  "test_cases": [
    {
      "id": "TC-001",
      "title": "Verify merchant and payment batch search loads under 1.5s",
      "description": "Ensure OpsAnalyst can search merchants and payment batches and receive results from both PaymentCore and Payment Rail APIs within SLA.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["User logged in as OpsAnalyst", "API Gateway operational"],
      "steps": ["Open search UI", "Enter merchant ID and date range", "Click Search", "Measure response time"],
      "expected_result": "Search results appear within 1.5s showing merchant and batch info merged from both APIs.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-002",
      "title": "Validate settlement timeline renders correctly per rail type",
      "description": "Confirm batch timelines aggregate ACH, RTP, and wire events correctly from Payment Rail APIs.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["Valid batchId in PaymentCore", "Payment Rail APIs return timeline data"],
      "steps": ["Invoke GET /api/batches/{batchId}/settlement-timeline", "Inspect railEvents grouping", "Open UI timeline component"],
      "expected_result": "Settlement events appear grouped by rail type with correct timestamps and statuses.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-003",
      "title": "Trigger refund emits audit logs to Kafka and S3",
      "description": "Verify refund initiation posts to Payment Actions service and creates audit entries.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["User has OpsAnalyst role", "Kafka broker reachable", "S3 bucket configured"],
      "steps": ["Invoke POST /api/actions/refund with paymentId", "Check HTTP 200 response", "Verify audit log in Kafka topic and S3 archive"],
      "expected_result": "Refund action succeeds and audit data is stored in both Kafka and S3.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-004",
      "title": "Approve payout only accessible for Manager role",
      "description": "Validate RBAC gating prevents unauthorized users from approving payouts.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["Users with OpsAnalyst, Manager, and Auditor roles available"],
      "steps": ["Attempt payout approval as OpsAnalyst", "Attempt payout approval as Manager", "Attempt payout approval as Auditor"],
      "expected_result": "Only Manager receives 200 Approved response; other roles receive 403 Access Denied.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-005",
      "title": "Audit-ready report generates and downloads successfully",
      "description": "Ensure Auditor can export audit logs from S3 archive in chosen format.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["User logged in as Auditor", "S3 archive contains audit data"],
      "steps": ["Select date range", "Choose CSV export", "Trigger download", "Verify file contents include expected actions and timestamps"],
      "expected_result": "System generates downloadable CSV/XLSX report containing valid audit logs.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-006",
      "title": "Display anomaly alerts for payment batches",
      "description": "Verify real-time alerts appear for anomalies detected in Payment Rail streams.",
      "test_type": "Integration",
      "preconditions": ["A batch with known anomalies exists", "WebSocket/SSE connection established"],
      "steps": ["Open batch detail view", "Verify alert list shows type and severity", "Inspect alert click navigation link"],
      "expected_result": "Alerts for delays or mismatches appear with proper severity and investigation link.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-007",
      "title": "Negative test - Unauthorized refund attempt blocked",
      "description": "Ensure refund trigger cannot be executed by non-OpsAnalyst roles.",
      "test_type": "Security",
      "preconditions": ["User logged in as Manager or Auditor"],
      "steps": ["Attempt POST /api/actions/refund", "Observe response code and message"],
      "expected_result": "System returns 403 authorization error, no audit log generated.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-008",
      "title": "Performance - Payout initiation round-trip <4s",
      "description": "Measure time taken for payout approval and disbursement confirmation.",
      "test_type": "Performance",
      "preconditions": ["API Gateway configured", "Manager role available", "Network stable"],
      "steps": ["Initiate payout approval via UI", "Capture timestamps for request/response"],
      "expected_result": "Full round-trip completes under 4s with audit entry generated.",
      "priority": "High"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-009",
      "title": "Audit log retry mechanism functions on delivery failure",
      "description": "Simulate Kafka downtime and ensure auditEmitter retries or logs errors properly.",
      "test_type": "Unit",
      "preconditions": ["Kafka broker temporarily unavailable"],
      "steps": ["Trigger refund action", "Check auditEmitter logs", "Verify retry attempt or error handling behavior"],
      "expected_result": "AuditEmitter either performs retry or logs failure without data loss.",
      "priority": "Medium"
    },
    {
      "id": "TC-010",
      "title": "End-to-end RBAC access matrix validation",
      "description": "Verify all protected endpoints enforce proper role-based access.",
      "test_type": "E2E",
      "preconditions": ["All user types provisioned with tokens"],
      "steps": ["Iterate over API endpoints with different tokens", "Capture status codes"],
      "expected_result": "Access pattern matches RBAC matrix: OpsAnalyst(search/refund), Manager(approval), Auditor(report).",
      "priority": "High"
    }
  ],
  "test_data_requirements": [
    "Sample merchants with varying regions and statuses",
    "Payment batches across ACH, RTP, and wire rails",
    "Test payment IDs for refund initiation",
    "Pending payout IDs requiring Manager approval",
    "Audit log samples for export validation",
    "Synthetic anomaly event payloads (delayed, mismatched amounts)",
    "User tokens/credentials representing OpsAnalyst, Manager, Auditor"
  ],
  "automation_approach": "Use Jest for backend unit tests (controllers, middleware, auditEmitter). Employ Supertest for Express API integration. Cypress E2E tests will automate UI flows—search, refund, approval, report export—executing via headless CI runners. Performance tests using Locust target /api/payouts/approve and /api/merchants/search endpoints. Security tests will run OWASP ZAP scans and automated RBAC role validation scripts in CI pipeline. All test data seeded via mock GraphQL and REST API simulators inside VNet. GitHub Actions or internal runner triggers will run nightly regression suites.",
  "coverage_goals": "Achieve >=90% unit test coverage for all controllers and utilities, 100% role access validation, 95% API integration coverage (positive + negative paths), E2E verification for 100% user stories, performance compliance for critical operations (<1.5s search, <4s payouts), and audit emission validation in 100% of relevant actions."
}

{
  "summary": "The sprint successfully delivered a secure, production-ready Payment Admin Workspace empowering Treasury Operations to manage merchant searches, settlements, refunds, anomaly alerts, and payout approvals with audit-compliant visibility. The workspace unites PaymentCore and Payment Rail data, automates operational workflows, and reduces reconciliation time, improving audit readiness and compliance across regions while maintaining strong ROI through process efficiency gains.",
  "scope_overview": "This release covers deployment of a unified Next.js 14 + TypeScript-based workspace for Treasury Ops analysts and managers. Key deliverables include merchant/batch search, settlement timeline visualization, refund and approval workflows with RBAC, real-time anomaly alerts, and audit-ready reporting. Integrations with PaymentCore (GraphQL) and Payment Rail APIs are complete, all actions are logged to Kafka and S3, and performance targets have been validated.",
  "key_risks": [
    "Persistent API latency could impact search and payout SLAs if upstream services degrade.",
    "Potential audit emission failures during Kafka or S3 downtime may threaten compliance traceability."
  ],
  "test_readiness": "QA validation confirms readiness for production: all critical workflows pass E2E and integration tests, RBAC enforcement validated for all roles, audit log emission verified under failover scenarios, and performance benchmarks met (<1.5s search, <4s payouts). Automated regression and nightly tests will sustain release stability post-deployment.",
  "recommendations": [
    "Establish continuous monitoring for API latency and audit log delivery status.",
    "Expand anomaly detection analytics to improve exception prediction and reduce manual investigations."
  ],
  "next_steps": [
    "Deploy workspace to Treasury Operations under controlled rollout and collect user feedback within the first week.",
    "Coordinate with infra and compliance teams to extend alerting for audit emission and API performance metrics."
  ]
}
